title: One-Tap Reviews & a Clearer Map
changes: Review starts with one tap — your mode, card face, and filters are remembered between sessions
Mid-session progress is saved: refresh or switch apps and pick up where you left off
Undo now really undoes — the rating, XP, and scheduling are all reverted
Keyboard shortcuts while reviewing: Space to flip, 1–4 to rate, U to undo
Interval previews on every rating button in every mode, and the Hard button is available on mobile
New cards are labelled, and you choose how many new cards each session introduces
Test mode advances automatically after you answer
Practicing missed cards no longer affects their schedule
Simpler navigation: Home · Review · Learn · Profile on mobile; Stories lives under Learn
Home shows your streak, today's goal, and what to continue — signing in lands you there
Shorter, skippable welcome that starts you with notes or a course
Daily goal, new-cards-per-session, audio, and Hard-button preferences are editable in Profile
Uploads now confirm success (or tell you what went wrong) with a real completion step
Lessons from courses and the community are labelled and no longer shift your own lesson numbering
Lessons prompt you to regenerate interactive pages after their cards change
Lesson exercises remember your answers, and finishing one offers to review its cards
Select and organise cards from the deck on mobile
Stories: tap any word for pinyin and meaning, add new words to your deck, and see generation progress
Empty screens now point you somewhere useful
